uzo.purpose: Represents a person or thing with a picture or initials.

instead.kialo: A status is a word next to what it describes, because a picture says who and not how; that is the insigno.
A logo keeps the colours and the shape of its brand, because it is the brand's own picture; a round crop with initials would change it, and Fundamento does not carry it yet.

boundary.kialo: Overlapping avatars hide each other and need a count of the rest, because a stack only says how many; a person decides how many show and what the rest is called.
A dot on the picture says a state by colour alone, because it has no word (WCAG 1.4.1); a person decides how the presence is said in words.

containers.name: karto
containers.kialo: An avatar stands in the meta row of a card, because it says who the thing belongs to.

containers.name: tabelo
containers.kialo: An avatar stands in the cell before a name, because a face is found faster than a word; the name beside it makes it decorative.

containers.name: page-header
containers.kialo: A large avatar stands in the header of a profile, because the page is about that person.

with.kialo: A status of the person stands beside the avatar as a badge, because the picture says who and the word says how; never as a dot on the picture.
